row: APRC Health & Physiotherapy by Dr Irfan Ahmed

Welcome to APRC (Acti-Life Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation Center) — Lahore’s top choice for back pain, neck pain, shoulder pain, post-surgical rehab, and sports injuries. APRC is the only physiotherapy center in Lahore with a fully equipped gym and latest treatment technologies. Our expert male and female physiotherapists treat over 300+ hip and knee replacement cases annually — more than any hospital in Pakistan.

Dr. Irfan Ahmed (PT, DPT), Chief Physical Therapist, brings 20+ years of experience in orthopedic and sports injury rehab.

🎥 On this channel, find videos in Urdu/Hindi/English on pain relief, physiotherapy exercises, fitness, and recovery tips.

📞 Appointments: +92 321 4722540
🌐 Visit: www.aprc.com.pk

Subscribe for expert guidance and trusted rehab care.

Disclaimer: This content on this  channel is for informational purposes only and is not medical advice. Always consult a doctor before starting new exercises or routines.*
